notes.title: Golf Pool V2.0 released!
notes.content:
A Major update for Golf Pool VR has been released. a new Fine-tune system, Increase accuracy, a global Leaderboard, and an Arcade mode that includes 10 challenging levels. 
Do please replay the tutorial level to understand the new system.

Don't forget to leave your feedback on the discord channel https://discord.com/invite/ZGAHEuA
